stages.solutionSteps: 1. C-ն A-ի և B-ի միջև՝ 5։ 2. A-ն C-ի և B-ի միջև՝ 19։

stages.headlineEnglish: A segment is split in ratio 2 : 3; it is 25 cm long. Find the larger part.
stages.problemText: A segment is split in ratio 2 : 3; it is 25 cm long. Find the larger part.
